title: Draft a User Communication
description: Write a non-technical update for users during a network outage.
problemStatement:
The Incident Commander has authorized the isolation of the 'Marketing' VLAN due to a confirmed malware outbreak. This will affect 150 users for an estimated 2-4 hours. You are the Communications Lead.

**Task:** Write a **3-4 sentence** email/Slack message to be sent to the affected Marketing department employees.

**Requirements:**
- Acknowledge the disruption.
- Provide a temporary workaround (use Guest Wi-Fi).
- Provide a timeframe for the next update.
- **Do NOT mention malware, hacking, or security incidents.**

**Output Format:** Plain text message.
hints: Use terms like 'network maintenance' or 'technical issue'.
Give a specific time for the next update (e.g., 'We will update you by 3:00 PM').
expectedOutput: Attention Marketing Team: We are currently experiencing a network issue affecting wired connections on the Marketing floor. Our IT team is actively investigating and working to resolve this. In the meantime, please connect to the 'Corp-Guest' Wi-Fi network using your standard credentials to access email and internet. We will provide another update by 3:00 PM ET. Thank you for your patience.
solutionCode: Attention Marketing Team: We are currently addressing a technical issue impacting network connectivity on the Marketing VLAN. As a workaround, please switch to the 'Corp-Guest' Wi-Fi network to maintain access to email and critical applications. Our team is working to restore full service as quickly as possible, and we will send a status update by 3:00 PM Eastern Time. We appreciate your understanding.
